properties.name: Which calls settle intent is declared once, served on the tool under _meta["reflow2/settles"], and read by reflow2's own signature checks; collapse_decision takes an approver
properties.rationale: THE CAUSE (dev_reflow2 two-agent exercise, art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, item I2): which calls settle intent lived in each handler (status != 'proposed' here, enforced.is_some() there, accepted|deferred in a third) and was said nowhere a program could read. flo2's gateway, which signs settles on its signed-in caller's behalf, had to guess, guessed 'an argument named status', and let add_design_rule's enforced through unsigned (flo2 fact:root-cause-the-gateway-reads-settling-from-a-field-named-status-and-lets-an-enforced-rule-through-unsigned-2026-09-29); flo2 #102 contained it with a hand-kept copy, SETTLES in services/edge-gateway/src/identity.ts, recorded as contained_symptom. collapse_decision settled a Decision with no approver parameter at all (fact:collapse-decision-settles-a-decision-with-no-approver-and-says-nothing-2026-09-28, which lives in the live design and is closed there by hand). WHY THIS REMOVES THE CAUSE: the rule is declared once and both served and read, so a gateway and reflow2 cannot disagree, and a tool that takes an approver cannot ship without a declaration. PINNED, observed failing on a clean origin/main build (449ba2b) under the shared build lock: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/every_settling_call_declares_what_settles_it.rs, 3 of 3 failed ('only 0 served tools declare what settles them (floor 9)'; 'only 0 declared tools were driven'; collapse_decision refused `approver` as an unknown field). FOR flo2 AT ITS MOVE TO THE RELEASE THAT CARRIES THIS: read tools/list's _meta["reflow2/settles"] per tool, evaluate `when` against the call's `argument`, fill the signed-in caller at `approver` (per item for `list[].approver`), and drop the SETTLES copy and its catalog test; its real-binary test then checks the served declarations instead.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: ONE TABLE (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/settles.rs, SETTLES) now holds, per tool, which argument settles intent, which values settle, where the signature goes, and what an unsigned settle does (refused | recorded_with_note). Every handler computes 'does this call settle?' and 'what happens when it names nobody?' from it (settles::rule, settles::gate), and tools/list serves each row on its tool as _meta["reflow2/settles"] = {version:1, argument, when: always | present | {in:[..]} | {not_in:[..]}, approver: 'approver' | 'gaps[].approver', unsigned}. Nine tools declare: add_requirement, add_decision, add_design_rule (refused); set_requirement_status, set_decision_status, collapse_decision, acknowledge_gap, acknowledge_defect, acknowledge_gaps (recorded_with_note). collapse_decision gains approver + acted_at and draws AUTHORED_BY role=approver; acknowledge_gaps now names the items that carry nobody's name.
